pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: src/lib/harness/executor.ts:124 parseAreaResult asserts the agent's free-text JSON into ParsedAreaResult with no check, so a reply missing features or learnings throws at src/lib/harness/orchestrator.ts:207 and any string is written into feature.status as a FeatureStatus

techniques.evidence: src/lib/harness/executor.ts:124 the one door for LLM output is an unmarked, invariant-free cast, so the region is neither enclosed behind a checked surface nor carries the fact that would make it valid

src/lib/harness/orchestrator.ts:19 the loop imports executeArea (which spawns the claude CLI, executor.ts:167) and verify (execSync) directly with no enabling point, and git ls-files shows no test under src/lib/harness, so the area status transitions are reachable only by spawning a real CLI
src/lib/harness/types.ts:10 status vocabularies are closed unions; depth of the orchestrator/executor split not judged

pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: src/features/settings/sub_portability/components/export-prototype/useExportPicker.ts:431 the closed AthenaTier set ('core'|'learned', src/api/system/dataPortability.ts:18) is widened to Set<string> at :100 and re-asserted 'as AthenaTier[]' at the IPC payload with no stated invariant, so any string id toggled under 'athena' reaches the export command typed as a tier

techniques.evidence: src/features/settings/sub_portability/components/export-prototype/useExportPicker.ts:431 data-boundary assertion with no comment naming the invariant (the repo's own convention requires one)

src/features/settings/sub_portability/components/export-prototype/useExportPicker.ts:100 the tier vocabulary the API owns is held in an open type, so membership is enforced by nothing between toggle and the wire

pairs.subject: module-design
pairs.evidence: src/features/browser/whitelist/AddSiteModal.tsx:64 the add form blocks submit on browserOriginProblem, a hand-written TS re-statement (src/features/browser/types.ts:203 'null when the value is something Rust will accept') of Rust's parse_origin_pattern (src-tauri/core/src/models/browser.rs:436) with no shared fixture, so grammar drift either makes a valid origin unenterable or lets a doomed one through

techniques.evidence: src/features/browser/types.ts:203 one decision (the origin-pattern grammar) encoded in two hand-maintained modules with nothing comparing them - information leakage
src/features/browser/whitelist/siteEdit.ts:49 planSiteWrites is a pure diff of row vs draft into SiteWrite commands, with applySiteWrites (:71) as the only driver doing I/O
src/features/browser/whitelist/siteEdit.ts:49 multi-output planning written as explicit sequential code, the form the technique prescribes for that condition

techniques.evidence: src/features/templates/sub_n8n/steps/N8nSessionList.tsx:178 step vocabulary owned by the backend restated in the UI with no compiler-walked link - information leakage
